Market today: The market mood is mixed, with inflation expected to remain sticky, which can be a drag on growth and tech names. However, positive news from Micron offers a potential bright spot for the chip sector, which is key for your portfolio.

Your holdings: Three leveraged positions need immediate attention: MUU (-14.87%), SOXL (-42.21%), and SPAL (-20.1%). These are all flagged "SELL" and their leveraged nature means drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin. SOXL's stop at 200 is far above its current price of 129.89 and needs urgent review.

Watch: Keep an eye on broader inflation data, as sticky inflation impacts your tech-heavy book. Also, watch for any follow-through on the Micron news for the chip sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged "SELL" positions, especially given your margin exposure.
plays: MUU: Respect the stop at 31.6. This leveraged position is very close to your defined exit.
SPAL: Respect the stop at 21.38. This leveraged position is also near its stop.
SOXL: Re-evaluate the stop at 200. It's far above the current price of 129.89 and not protecting capital on this leveraged, losing position.
